Callout 1 points at the field at its initial minimum height with two lines of text ("Lorem ipsum dolor sit, consectetur adipiscing elit. Lacus vel etiam|") and the counter "67/200"; callout 2 points at the field grown in height to six lines of text, near its maximum size, with the counter "198/200".

13e7e521eca88b0d1920a890a7db331c661cf75a.caption: Two medium textareas, each with the label "Label", the text "Input" and the counter "0/100", with a circle highlighting the bottom right corner of each field. Callout 1 points at the left textarea, which has no resize handle (automatic scaling); callout 2 points at the right textarea, which has a resize handle in that corner (manual scaling).

3c9d30b563232ad5d25ca24a932d817012e16163.caption: Don't example: a medium textarea (Label, "Input", resize handle, counter "0/100") stretched across the full width of the 12-column main grid. The textarea should not span the whole main grid area; it belongs in the content area narrow and should not exceed the recommended maximum width of 544px, for better scanability and readability.

417835b454159b4964381bed0b4408451f4afc4e.caption: Two textareas (Label, "Input", "0/100") inside a "Content area Narrow" container. In the first the field fills the container width; in the second the container is wider than the field, and the field stays at the "recommended max. width 544px" while "Container Width" extends beyond it.

53ee54e0cc3aa446cbd5ce0b2451c80456bfa170.caption: Medium textarea with the label "Label" and a resize handle, filled with six lines of Lorem ipsum text and the counter "67/200". The text is taller than the maximum height, so a native vertical scroll bar appears on the right inside the textarea.

649daddfdf1c86d5367c5e7db530a68c6900727f.caption: Two medium textareas with "Input" and "0/100": the first with the label "Label *", where callout 1 points at the asterisk marking a required field; the second with the label "Label (optional)", where callout 2 points at the word "(optional)" marking an optional field.

9e4a90785e35d639653af9d3692f19d279f834a9.caption: Overview of the textarea in sizes "Size Medium" and "Size Small", each in the states Default, Hover (grey fill), Focus (thick black border), Near limit, Limit reached, Disabled (greyed text) and Read-only (grey fill, no border). Each has a Label, lorem ipsum hint text, an input area with resize handle and a counter. Near limit shows the info message "Less than 20% of characters left" with "90/100", Limit reached the warning "Character limit reached" with "100/100". Default and Focus also have an "is invalid" variant with the label "Label *" and the error "System Feedback Message"; the invalid Default field has a red border.

b6fdb43afaefe57c0f0de431a3319c858fe29553.caption: Medium textarea with the label "Label", an info button next to it (hovered with a pointer cursor), the placeholder "Input", a resize handle and the counter "0/100". Above the info button an open white popover with the text "You will usually find the Machine Number in the location shown in the illustrations" shows two line drawings of a STIHL engine unit and a trimmer, each with a leader line to a placeholder machine number "xxxxxxxxx".

be12d266e5693e1761836b0ca7a6ccff7c95876c.caption: Do example with four textareas, each with a resize handle. Callout 1 points at the counter "57/100" of a field with two lines of text; callout 2 at the info message "Less than 20% of characters left" of a field at "161/200"; callout 3 at the counter "100/100" of a full field with the warning "Character limit reached"; callout 4 at the error "System Feedback Message" of an empty required field ("Label *") with a red border and the counter "0/100".

cc961d4158df60309b0b55124560340aac50381c.caption: Don't example: a medium textarea with the label "Label", an info button (hovered), the placeholder "Input", a resize handle and the counter "0/100", with a small white popover above the info button containing only the placeholder text "xxxx". This is wrong because the popover must not hold critical or required information; use the hint instead.

d7972fb5526ed73466df56d89a4594b8a2b3f1c3.caption: Anatomy of the textarea in five examples. In the first, callout 1 points at the Label, 2 at the text area, 3 at the user input text "Input" and 4 at the character count "0/100". The second adds 5, the hint text below the label, and 6, the info button next to the label. The last three show the system feedback: 7a the info message "Less than 20% of characters left" at "90/100", 7b the warning "Character limit reached" at "100/100", and 7c the error "System Feedback Message" under a required field ("Label *") with a red border.
